reviewed_by: Claude review of streaming context-length recovery
reason: _stream_openai_compatible's generic except yielded a StreamEventType.ERROR event without context_length_exceeded, while the non-streaming fallback in ModelProvider.stream sets it from isinstance(exc, ProviderContextLengthError). chat.py's _stream_with_context_recovery only compacts and retries once when that flag is set, so an OpenRouter, vLLM or Ollama profile in streaming mode failed the turn with 'provider returned HTTP 400: ... context length' where the same profile without streaming recovered. The except now carries the flag. test_providers gains a streaming 400 context_length_exceeded case asserting STARTED, ERROR with the flag set (False on main); the rest of the file covers _safe_error classification, retries and the other streaming paths.
exclusions: No frontend tests: no ui/ change. No native tests: no Tauri or Rust change. No Playwright: area:core-api (the remaining-core fallback for providers.py) is the real-Core journey suite and cannot make a provider reject on context length; the Python test drives the transport with httpx.MockTransport. No full suites.
